title: Many Democrats Are Avoiding Kamala Harris. Abdul El-Sayed Is Welcoming Her.
summary: The former vice president wants to help her party in the midterms, but not many are taking her up on the offer. Except for the Senate nominee in Michigan, who will appear with her on Tuesday.
